label: Confirm Dialogs
title: Confirm Dialog Fix — Cancel Actually Works Now
subtitle: Every confirm() in the app used the global window.confirm, which Tauri intercepts asynchronously — since a pending Promise is truthy, Cancel never actually blocked anything anywhere, dialog or no dialog. Fixed 2026-08-19 by switching every call site to the awaited @tauri-apps/plugin-dialog confirm(). Cuts across features, not just Phase 4 — see docs/archive/bugs.md and docs/archive/engineering_backlog.md for the full writeup.

sections.title: Clear Selected (untracked rows only)
items: Check one or more untracked rows, click Clear Selected — a real dialog appears (not silent)
Click Cancel on that dialog — the row(s) are NOT removed, queue unchanged
Click OK — the row(s) ARE removed as expected

sections.title: Clear All (nothing tracked in the queue)
items: With an all-untracked queue, click Clear All — a real dialog appears (not silent)
Click Cancel on that dialog — nothing is removed, queue unchanged
Click OK — the queue is cleared as expected

sections.title: Demo Auditor — delete duplicate files
items: Run an audit, check one or more duplicate files, click Delete — a real dialog appears
Click Cancel — the files are NOT deleted, still shown in the duplicates list
Click OK — the files ARE deleted as expected

sections.title: Capture Studio — delete orphaned preview demos
items: Open Clear Previews, check one or more orphaned preview demos, click Delete — a real dialog appears
Click Cancel — the files are NOT deleted, still shown in the list
Click OK — the files ARE deleted as expected

sections.title: Row Delete fallback path
items: Confirm `requestTrackedDeleteConfirm` is always wired via initMasterPane in normal operation — this fallback confirm() only fires if that wiring is ever missing, so it's not expected to be exercisable through the UI as shipped; no action needed unless refactoring master_pane.js's init call
